name: HAProxy
description: Reads what HAProxy is listening on and which servers are behind each backend through the Data Plane API, and can take one server out of the rotation for a maintenance window.

config.label: Data Plane API address
config.hint: Where the Data Plane API answers, for example https://lb1.dc2.example.com:5555. The management address, not the one traffic arrives on.

config.label: API user
config.hint: The user from HAProxy's own userlist. The password is written separately, on the Adapters screen, and is never stored here.

config.label: API version
config.hint: v2 or v3. The Data Plane API changes its paths between major versions, so this is asked rather than guessed.

config.label: Verify the certificate
config.hint: Turn this off only for a balancer using its own self-signed certificate on a management network you control.

config.label: Timeout (seconds)
config.hint: A balancer under load must not become an operator staring at a spinner.
